name: setup-trusted-publishing
description: Publish a 0.0.0 stub to npm so OIDC trusted publishing can be configured

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-test-isolation=process --test tests/access.test.ts tests/packument.test.ts tests/stub.test.ts tests/registry.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && git add package.json CHANGELOG.md
scripts.release: pnpm run build && npm stage publish
